A design that fits your business

A consistent layout, colours and type, shaped around your brand and the people you want to reach.

Clear pages and navigation

The agreed pages and sections, with a clear route from learning about your services to getting in touch.

Mobile-friendly layouts

Layouts prepared for phone, tablet and desktop, with readable text and easy-to-use buttons.

Enquiry options

Contact forms, email links and WhatsApp links where they help customers take the next step. Form delivery is tested on the connected hosting.

Basic on-page SEO

Descriptive page titles, headings, meta descriptions, image alt text and a sitemap. Search rankings are not guaranteed.

Loading and usability checks

Optimised images, considered use of motion, and checks of navigation, forms and common screen sizes before launch.

Launch support

Help connecting the finished site to your domain and compatible hosting, including HTTPS and the agreed launch checks.

Ownership and handover

The final agreed source files and assets, plus an explanation of hosting and future updates. Third-party services keep their own licence terms.

Good questions

A few useful answers.

Open the details you need.

How much will my website cost?

The price depends on the pages, features, content and integrations. Share your requirements and I’ll provide a scope and quote. Domain, hosting, paid tools and ongoing maintenance are separate unless the quote explicitly includes them.

How long does it take?

The timeline depends on the scope and how quickly content and feedback are available. We agree a realistic schedule before starting; I don’t promise the same deadline for every website.

Do you use AI to build the website?

Yes. I use AI-assisted tools for parts of the design and development process, then review and refine the output. Your business requirements guide the work, and the final pages, links and forms need testing before launch.

Will I own the website?

You receive the final agreed website source and assets after the agreed payment terms are met. Your domain and hosting should stay in your own accounts. Any licensed fonts, images or third-party tools remain subject to their own terms.

Can I edit the website later?

We choose an editing approach during planning. A coded website usually needs code changes; an editor or CMS can be included if it is part of the agreed scope. Ongoing updates and support can be discussed separately.

Will the website guarantee enquiries or Google rankings?

No. A website can make your offer clearer and make contacting you easier, but enquiries depend on traffic, demand, your offer and follow-up. Basic SEO setup does not guarantee search rankings.
